thread:
Nina: Heads-up: final coordination thread for Wed 11am PT release. We need: 1) final changelog bullets, 2) docs permalink, 3) benchmark soundbites for the blog/webinar, and 4) SDR routing details. Who can confirm timelines?

Omar: Can confirm infra timeline. Canary Mon 08:00 PT, staged rollout Tue 14:00 PT, global flip Wed 11:00 PT. Will post canary health updates here.

Priti: Draft changelog bullets (please edit):
- GA: streaming + function call support with token-level streaming.
- Dedicated: burst capacity and updated SLA language.
- Optimize: new auto-batching heuristics and cache-aware quant profiles.
- Known limit: int8 fallback may increase latency on >1024 tokens; noted under caveats.

Luca: Docs: publishing from staging -> production pipeline. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-q1-v2 (will be overwritten when we push). Public permalink will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2. ETA publish Tue 19:30 PT after changelog PR merges.

Nina: Can marketing hold on copy until PR links are final? Need PRs to reference for legal and press kit.

Omar: Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7627 (waiting CI). Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1210 (staging preview linked above). CI ETA: Tue 17:45 PT.

ops-bot: deploy:canary cluster-bravo Mon 08:00 PT
ops-bot: health:canary OK Mon 08:20 PT

Priti: Benchmarks to quote (short, conservative): "~15% reduction in 95th-percentile latency on 512-token chat workloads; ~20% throughput gain with KV cache enabled." Full perf table attached to the docs PR.

Andrea: Webinar: Thu 10am PT. Marketing will fire promo Wed 12:00 PT. Landing page draft: https://marketing.redwood.ai/launch/v2-preview. Need final docs URL + UTM list to wire SDR routing.

Luca: Regional note: APAC region deploy lags by ~3 hours; EU will be caught up by Wed ~14:00 PT. Recommend delaying any EU-only outreach until 15:00 PT.

Nina: Embargo suggestion: internal + partners until Wed 10:00 PT, public at 11:00 PT. That gives 1h buffer for final checks. Legal ok with embargo window.

Omar: Also adding observability runbook: if tail latency spikes >25% post-flip, rollback to previous model image and toggle caching filters off. I'll be oncall Wed 10:30-12:00 PT.

Priti: I'll refine the changelog bullets and add the "notes and limits" section re: int8. Will paste final markdown once PR passes.

Andrea: SDR routing: webhook endpoint /webhooks/marketing/leads ready. Required params: utm_source=announce, utm_campaign=v2-launch, region. I'll add tests after docs URL is final.

Nina: Great. Action items: Omar will post final CI status + canary health, Luca will publish docs and post the live permalink, Priti will paste final changelog markdown, Andrea will finalize UTM list. Marketing will not schedule public posts until the live docs permalink is confirmed.

ops-bot: deploy:rollout global Tue 14:00 PT -> target Wed 11:00 PT

Omar: CI green, merging changelog PR Tue 17:50 PT. Will ping after merge.

Luca: Docs merged and CDN invalidation started. Live permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2. Live now.

Priti: Final changelog (paste below):
- Streaming & function calls: GA with streaming tokens and structured call hints.
- Dedicated capacity: burst capacity and clarified SLA tiers.
- Redwood Optimize: new auto-batching/caching heuristics and quant recommendations.

Priti: Notes & limits: int8 paths may degrade latency for sequences >1024 tokens; we recommend full-precision or hybrid quant for long-context evals.

Andrea: UTM payload ready and SDR webhook tested with live docs URL. All set on my side.

Nina: Thanks team 389680 Marketing will schedule the blog + social for Wed 11:00 PT. Andrea to share final landing page link once CMS publishes. I'll close when promo is live.

Andrea: Landing page published: https://marketing.redwood.ai/launch/v2 (final). Routing live.

Nina: Window closed 4aa good work everyone.
